method.cold: OS caches uncontrolled; first query is first use on a fresh/restored DB, not cold disk IO
method.w1: refreshSummary entry through all COMMIT and return; DB setup measured separately; first lazy query separately and directly summed per trial
method.diagnostics: Separate extra trial; get/all/iterate returned rows+column values, total_changes, TEMP allocation; not included in timed samples
method.common: Actual scanner, parsers, normalization staging TEMP, manifest/name/cost/capability facts and FK retained
method.candidate: No usage_* tables, no replacement/diff TEMP, same facts PKs; six secondary indexes; JS sets+indexed per-session DELETE/INSERT
method.note: User requested A/B of whole designs. B is a combined design change, not index-only delta attribution; PK-only experiment intentionally outside scope.

counters.scanstatus: unavailable: node:sqlite StatementSync exposes no scanstatus API
counters.stmtStatus: unavailable: node:sqlite exposes no VM_STEP/FULLSCAN_STEP/SORT counters
counters.physicalIO: unmeasured: no VFS/OS IO tracing; bodyBytes is original reader output, not physical disk IO
counters.peakMemory: unmeasured: shared-process RSS cannot isolate synchronous peaks

method.precision: Integers/counts exact; average tolerance 1e-9 relative; result hashes only, no source text/title/path/session identifiers
method.percentile: Nearest lower rank floor((n-1)*p); 9 read/5 write batches; large W1 uses 3 due to 10,000 parser+COMMIT cost; each query sample averages 3 calls
method.noAnalyzeOverride: Product optimize behavior retained; same PRAGMAs on both; no manual ANALYZE or checkpoint inside measured refresh
hypotheses: B removes rollup rows and maintenance; storage/setup/refresh should shrink unless redundant indexes and JS per-session work dominate.
B date/project indexes restrict narrow scans, but all-range queries still group matching model facts N; A processes rollup rows R.
A should benefit most when a long session compresses many requests into few days; with one request/session R is about N and wide rollup rows may cost more.
B rewrites the entire changed session even for +1; A diff threshold is oldCount>=1000 and changes<=min(32,floor(oldCount/10)). +33/+50 exercise fallback.
method.userOverride: 2026-10-31 user: prioritize queries/incremental; large initial ingestion A/B once each.
method.largeInitial: One sequential observation A then B. No warmup or heavy diagnostic rerun. No dispersion claim. Progress output once per 500 commits is included.
method.largeLongInitial: Reuse normal 10,000-session snapshot and parse/replace only the changed 1,000-request session; no second full large initial ingestion.
method.incrementalBaseline: Large 9,950-state created from full snapshot by removing last 50 independent sessions through product API; prior history/freelist retained and disclosed.

SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULLIF(local_day, '') AS period,
      SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      SUM(turn_count) AS turn_count,
      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(r_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(r_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(r_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(r_duration_ms_known), 0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(r_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(r_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_approximate) AS approximate_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns,
      SUM(unknown_time_turns) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(stale_turns) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(last_successful_update) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (
      SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      session_id,
      local_day,
      model,
      model_key,
      input_tokens,
      output_tokens,
      total_tokens,
      turn_count,
      completed_turns,
      recorded_turns,
      recorded_completed_turns,
      cache_write_input_tokens,
      cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      cache_read_input_tokens,
      cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      c_input_tokens,
      c_output_tokens,
      c_total_tokens,
      c_cache_write_input_tokens,
      c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      c_cache_read_input_tokens,
      c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      c_duration_ms,
      c_duration_ms_known,
      c_exact,
      c_derived,
      c_approximate,
      c_duration_missing,
      r_input_tokens,
      r_output_tokens,
      r_total_tokens,
      r_cache_write_input_tokens,
      r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      r_cache_read_input_tokens,
      r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      r_duration_ms,
      r_duration_ms_known,
      r_exact,
      r_derived,
      r_approximate,
      r_duration_missing,
      unknown_time_turns,
      stale_turns,
      last_successful_update,
      min_started_at_ms
    FROM usage_model_daily AS turn_summary
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND ((local_day <> '' AND local_day >= ? AND local_day < ?))
    ) AS turn_summary
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))

SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE project_key = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

      r_approximate,
      r_duration_missing,
      unknown_time_turns,
      stale_turns,
      last_successful_update,
      min_started_at_ms
    FROM usage_model_daily AS turn_summary
    WHERE project_key = ?
      AND ((local_day <> '' AND 0 = 1))
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      session_id,
      coalesce(agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, 'day'), '') AS local_day,
      model,
      CASE
        WHEN model IS NULL THEN 'N'
        ELSE 'V' || model
      END AS model_key,
      SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
      SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
      SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      coalesce(SUM(cache_write_input_tokens),0) AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) AS cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(cache_read_input_tokens),0) AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) AS cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN input_tokens END),0) AS c_input_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN output_tokens END),0) AS c_output_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN total_tokens END),0) AS c_total_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_write_input_tokens END),0) AS c_cache_write_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) AS c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_read_input_tokens END),0) AS c_cache_read_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) AS c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1.0 * duration_ms END),0) AS c_duration_ms,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN duration_ms END) AS c_duration_ms_known,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS c_exact,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS c_derived,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS c_approximate,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS c_duration_missing,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END),0) AS r_input_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END),0) AS r_output_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END),0) AS r_total_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END),0) AS r_cache_write_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) AS r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END),0) AS r_cache_read_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) AS r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN 1.0 * duration_ms END),0) AS r_duration_ms,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS r_duration_ms_known,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS r_exact,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS r_derived,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS r_approximate,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS r_duration_missing,
      SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update,
      MIN(started_at_ms) AS min_started_at_ms
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE project_key = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) AND (started_at_ms < ? OR started_at_ms >= ?)
    GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id, local_day, model_key
          ) AS turn_summary
          GROUP BY provider, model, period, session_id
        )

schema.name: sessions

  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,

schema.name: turn_capability_usage
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE turn_capability_usage (

schema.name: turn_costs
schema.sql:

schema.name: turn_model_usage
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE turn_model_usage (
  turn_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES turn_summary(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

  output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(output_tokens >= 0),

schema.name: turn_summary
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE turn_summary (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider IN ('claude', 'codex')),
  project_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(project_key),
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  root_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_title TEXT,

    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,

      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      coalesce(SUM(cache_write_input_tokens),0) AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) AS cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(cache_read_input_tokens),0) AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) AS cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN input_tokens END),0) AS c_input_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN output_tokens END),0) AS c_output_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN total_tokens END),0) AS c_total_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_write_input_tokens END),0) AS c_cache_write_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) AS c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_read_input_tokens END),0) AS c_cache_read_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) AS c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1.0 * duration_ms END),0) AS c_duration_ms,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN duration_ms END) AS c_duration_ms_known,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS c_exact,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS c_derived,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS c_approximate,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS c_duration_missing,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END),0) AS r_input_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END),0) AS r_output_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END),0) AS r_total_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END),0) AS r_cache_write_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) AS r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END),0) AS r_cache_read_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) AS r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN 1.0 * duration_ms END),0) AS r_duration_ms,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS r_duration_ms_known,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS r_exact,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS r_derived,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS r_approximate,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS r_duration_missing,
      SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update,
      MIN(started_at_ms) AS min_started_at_ms
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE project_key = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) AND (started_at_ms < ? OR started_at_ms >= ?)
    GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id, local_day, model_key

        )

schema.name: turn_costs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE turn_costs (
  turn_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES turn_summary(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  billing_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(billing_mode IN ('subscription','api','unknown')),
  cost_usd REAL CHECK(cost_usd >= 0),
  unknown_costs INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unknown_costs >= 0),
  pricing_version TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: turn_model_usage
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE turn_model_usage (
  turn_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES turn_summary(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  model TEXT NOT NULL,
  input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(input_tokens >= 0),
  output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(output_tokens >= 0),
  cache_write_input_tokens INTEGER CHECK(cache_write_input_tokens >= 0),
  cache_read_input_tokens INTEGER CHECK(cache_read_input_tokens >= 0),
  estimated_cost_usd REAL CHECK(estimated_cost_usd >= 0),
  pricing_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(turn_id, model)
) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: turn_summary
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE turn_summary (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider IN ('claude', 'codex')),
  project_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(project_key),
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  root_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_title TEXT,
  started_at_ms INTEGER,
  completed_at_ms INTEGER,
  duration_ms INTEGER CHECK(duration_ms >= 0),
  duration_quality TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(duration_quality IN ('exact','derived','approximate','missing')),
  input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(input_tokens >= 0),
  output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(output_tokens >= 0),
  cache_write_input_tokens INTEGER CHECK(cache_write_input_tokens >= 0),
  cache_read_input_tokens INTEGER CHECK(cache_read_input_tokens >= 0),
  total_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(total_tokens = input_tokens + output_tokens),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('completed','in_progress','failed')),
  quality_flags TEXT,
  diagnostic_file_id INTEGER REFERENCES manifest(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  diagnostic_offset INTEGER,
  last_error TEXT,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(provider, session_id, root_turn_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(provider, session_id) REFERENCES sessions(provider, session_id)
)

    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)

    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,

      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN output_tokens END),0) AS c_output_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN total_tokens END),0) AS c_total_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_write_input_tokens END),0) AS c_cache_write_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) AS c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_read_input_tokens END),0) AS c_cache_read_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) AS c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1.0 * duration_ms END),0) AS c_duration_ms,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN duration_ms END) AS c_duration_ms_known,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS c_exact,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS c_derived,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS c_approximate,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS c_duration_missing,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END),0) AS r_input_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END),0) AS r_output_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END),0) AS r_total_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END),0) AS r_cache_write_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) AS r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END),0) AS r_cache_read_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) AS r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN 1.0 * duration_ms END),0) AS r_duration_ms,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS r_duration_ms_known,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS r_exact,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS r_derived,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS r_approximate,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS r_duration_missing,
      SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update,
      MIN(started_at_ms) AS min_started_at_ms
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE project_key = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) AND (started_at_ms < ? OR started_at_ms >= ?)
    GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id, local_day, model_key
          ) AS turn_summary
          GROUP BY provider, model, period, session_id
        )

schema.name: turn_summary
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE turn_summary (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider IN ('claude', 'codex')),
  project_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(project_key),
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  root_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_title TEXT,
  started_at_ms INTEGER,
  completed_at_ms INTEGER,
  duration_ms INTEGER CHECK(duration_ms >= 0),
  duration_quality TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(duration_quality IN ('exact','derived','approximate','missing')),
  input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(input_tokens >= 0),
  output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(output_tokens >= 0),
  cache_write_input_tokens INTEGER CHECK(cache_write_input_tokens >= 0),
  cache_read_input_tokens INTEGER CHECK(cache_read_input_tokens >= 0),
  total_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(total_tokens = input_tokens + output_tokens),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('completed','in_progress','failed')),
  quality_flags TEXT,
  diagnostic_file_id INTEGER REFERENCES manifest(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  diagnostic_offset INTEGER,
  last_error TEXT,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(provider, session_id, root_turn_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(provider, session_id) REFERENCES sessions(provider, session_id)
)

    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,

    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,

      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE project_key = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period, session_id
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?
